owner: Original Portal V2 Trusted Advisor assurance + website/CMS editorial owner
root_cause: Diverging sitewide navigation copy preserved stale selfscan question counts, an unsupported blanket two-week delivery promise and automatic email-report wording while the live scan provided a twelve-question anonymous instant result. Portal assurance incorrectly treated missing healthy metadata as positive and generic processing ok as independently verified outcome.
prevention_rule: Every publicly visible customer promise must be validated against the actual product flow; unknown source health is not green and generic ok cannot produce independently verified outcome. Claims require explicit provenance, evidence reference, review, protected release and production readback.
code_correction: Portal assurance now requires healthy===true; verifies all displayed outcomes only with explicit verification state AND proof reference.
Four primary landing pages and shared mobile navigation align free scan question count and avoid unqualified delivery promises.
Contact and scan no longer promise automatic mailed reports without requested email.
Original trust policy and original CMS editorial skill carry the rule.
